info.name: NexusMarket API
info.description: Requests in the order of the business flow (section 6.1). Run the folders top to bottom on a fresh server. Every request except login and buyer self-registration sends the X-User-Email header (RG-01). The initial administrator admin@nexusmarket.com is created at startup.
